title: Wind Turbine Maintenance Log Labelling Framework: LLM-Driven Data Correction and Enrichment via Semantic Extraction of Reliability Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2605.31281v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: As wind turbine fleets age, data-driven reliability engineering and maintenance optimisation are essential to manage lifecycle expenditure and support asset life extension. Historical maintenance records offer a vital source of field evidence, yet their analytical use is impeded by inconsistent system codes, generic categorical fields, and unstructured technician text. This paper presents a topology-aware large language model (LLM) workflow for reviewing legacy labels, extracting candidate maintenance and failure-mode taxonomies, and assigning structured semantic fields at record level. The workflow processed 16,316 maintenance records from 280 turbines across 32 onshore wind farms, spanning 9.2 years of operational history. It combines system-specific batch synthesis with granular labelling, deterministic exclusions, structured outputs, record-level provenance, and explicit review routes. translated_title: 风力涡轮机维护日志标注框架：通过语义提取可靠性情报实现基于大语言模型的数据校正与丰富化
translated_abstract: 摘要：随着风力涡轮机机群的老化，数据驱动的可靠性工程和维护优化对于管理生命周期支出和支持资产寿命延长至关重要。历史维护记录提供了现场证据的重要来源，但其分析用途受到不一致的系统代码、通用分类字段和非结构化技术人员文本的阻碍。本文提出了一种拓扑感知的大语言模型（LLM）工作流程，用于审查遗留标签、提取候选维护和故障模式分类法，并在记录级别分配结构化语义字段。该工作流程处理了来自32个陆上风电场280台涡轮机的16,316条维护记录，涵盖9.2年的运行历史。它结合了系统特定的批量合成与细粒度标注、确定性排除、结构化输出、记录级溯源和明确的审查路径。在三个系统协调的2,984条目标记录中...
tldr: 本文提出了一种拓扑感知的大语言模型工作流程，通过自动化语义提取和标注，成功校正并丰富了来自32个风电场280台涡轮机9.2年的维护记录数据，解决了历史维护数据中系统编码不一致和非结构化文本阻碍可靠性分析的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a topology-aware LLM workflow that automatically corrects and enriches 9.2 years of maintenance records from 280 turbines across 32 wind farms, addressing inconsistent system codes and unstructured text to enable data-driven reliability analysis.
